title: NOMAD-EEG: Native Omni-Montage Adaptive Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2610.35246v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Purpose. Electroencephalography (EEG) montages, channel counts and recording lengths vary widely, but most EEG foundation models are bound to the channel set and input length they were trained on. We aimed to build a generative EEG foundation model independent of the number, identity and order of electrodes and of the input length. Methods. NOMAD-EEG is a 12.0 M-parameter diffusion model that alternates state-space layers along time, without patches, with attention across electrodes identified only by their 3D scalp position. It was pre-trained on 147 h of unlabelled EEG from a single corpus and evaluated with frozen linear probes on ten datasets with 1 to 64 electrodes against seven foundation models run under one protocol, and on two unseen populations. Results. Despite its small size (12.0 M parameters against 69 M for REVE) and single pre- training corpus, NOMAD-EEG outperformed all seven foundation models on EEGMMIDB mo- tor imagery

translated_title: NOMAD-EEG：原生全导联自适应扩散模型
translated_abstract: 目的。脑电图（EEG）的导联配置、通道数量和记录时长差异很大，但大多数EEG基础模型都受限于其训练时所用的通道集合和输入长度。我们旨在构建一个不依赖于电极数量、电极身份、电极排列顺序以及输入长度的生成式EEG基础模型。方法。NOMAD-EEG是一个1200万参数的扩散模型，它在时间维度上交替使用状态空间层（无需分块处理），并在电极之间采用注意力机制，电极仅通过其在头皮上的3D位置来标识。该模型在来自单一语料库的147小时无标注EEG数据上进行预训练，并使用冻结线性探针，在同一评估协议下与七个基础模型进行比较，在十个包含1至64个电极的数据集上进行评估，还在两个未见过的群体上进行了测试。结果。尽管模型规模较小（1200万参数，相比之下REVE为6900万参数）且仅使用单一预训练语料库，NOMAD-EEG在EEGMMIDB运动想象任务上超越了所有七个基础模型。
tldr: 提出了仅1200万参数的生成式EEG基础模型NOMAD-EEG，其不依赖电极数量、身份、顺序和输入长度，仅用单一语料库147小时数据预训练即在多个数据集上超越了更大规模的现有基础模型。
en_tdlr: NOMAD-EEG is a compact 12.0M-parameter diffusion-based EEG foundation model, independent of electrode number, identity, order, and input length, which outperforms seven larger foundation models across diverse EEG datasets despite being pre-trained on only 147 hours from a single corpus.
